answer: Fingerprint escrow stops fakes. A new agent locks 40 POA in escrow, behavior-fingerprinted. The print is ferrous-hard: reshaping it breaks it. Funds release while it holds 20 epochs; a break freezes escrow and triggers review. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA against about 900 POA of pool share, so the attack loses money. Honest agents pay once, earn undiluted. Checks fall like a comet, unschedulable, each stamping an ivory pass.
